headline: Chainflip Token Drops 30% Following $4.86 Million Vault Drain
summary: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP token fell 30% after a suspected $4.86 million withdrawal from its vault using a valid signature.
why: Chainflip is a decentralized cross-chain exchange protocol that enables native asset swaps across blockchain networks.
